title: 首页（手机与「暂无应用」空状态）去掉「用 AI 搭建」和「搭建应用」两个入口
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW

Part of #36107. This follows the maintainer's ruling on 「Build with AI」 (7153161067 on #36908, 「「用 AI 搭建」 应该去掉」). The maintainer extended it in seat repo:objectstack#4's session, verbatim: 「手机首页和「暂无应用」空页面上的「用 AI 搭建」和「搭建应用」： A，一并去掉。」

## Context

From 768px up, the platform home page is retired (#36732). It renders only on a phone, or as the no-apps empty state (`App.tsx` `HomeRoute`). Two of its entries are covered by this card:
- the 「Build with AI」 call-to-action, shown when a build agent is deployed (`HomePage.tsx` ~289-334);
- the 「Build an app」 chip, which links to bare `/studio`.

## What

- Remove both entries from the home page, on the phone and in the desktop no-apps empty state.
- Keep 「Start from a template」, and any other entry that is not one of these two.
- Remove the now-unread i18n keys. They retire in 19.0.0 under 7153171432 / 7153326968. Declare them in this PR's changeset under 「Removed translation keys」, with `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`.

## Done when

- Neither entry renders in either state. The pins go red if either entry is restored.
- The no-apps empty state still offers a way to start an app, through the template entry.

Size S.

Blocked-by: #37166
